 Republican lawmakers redrew the congressional districts in Florida earlier this year with aims to capture up to four seats currently held by Democrats. Redistricting has left Democratic Reps. Jared Moskowitz, Kathy Castor and Darren Soto vulnerable, but Democrats are also eying the seats currently held by Republican Reps. Maria Elvira Salazar and Anna Paulina Luna.
